criterion: Neutral strips require 94% coverage/min224/tint30. Coherent warm frames require 98% coverage/min190/tint60 and at least 3 bounded sides of 2px or more. An isolated light strip requires 75% coverage/min185/tint60 and a matching transition. A gray hairline requires brightness of at least 30, limited variation across the edge, and 85% neutral pixels at least 12 levels brighter than both adjoining strips. An uneven pale margin requires at least two contiguous rows or columns with 78% pale neutral pixels and an abrupt drop into the next two strips. On any confirmed border, trim up to two further pixels while the median brightness falls by at least 17 and 70% of positions fall by at least 12, then inset two pixels to avoid resampling the line. Each side is bounded to 3.5%/24px and each dimension retains at least 92%.
